snippet.title: Tombwater Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Tombwater is coming November 12, 2025 on Steam!

Wishlist now https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308200/Tombwater/

Explore this Souls-Like Western through the accursed town of Tombwater to lay bare the eldritch horrors that lie within. Survive blood-spilling combat in this gruesome 2D action-RPG that might just drive you to madness.

STUDIO:  Moth Atlas
